# Nargish Banger - Digital Marketer & AI Tools Enthusiast

> Portfolio website of Nargish Banger, a Digital Marketer and Web Developer who explores AI tools to build smarter marketing strategies.

Also known as: Nargish, Nargishbanger

## Pages
- [Home](https://nargishportfolio.vercel.app/): About Nargish Banger, skills, and introduction
- [Projects](https://nargishportfolio.vercel.app/projects/): List of projects and case studies
- [Blog](https://nargishportfolio.vercel.app/blog.html): Articles on marketing, SEO, and AI tools
- [Contact](https://nargishportfolio.vercel.app/#contact): How to reach Nargish Banger

## About
Nargish Banger (also known as Nargish or Nargishbanger) is a Digital Marketer and Web Developer exploring AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Studio, Replit, Suno AI, VS Code) for marketing strategy, web development, and content creation.
